ModMetaData.name: RimWatch
ModMetaData.author: Ilya Volkov
ModMetaData.description:
🎭 FULL AUTOPILOT for RimWorld! AI plays for you - just watch your story unfold. Complete colony automation! 📺
🎮 v1.3.0 RELEASE (2025-12-09): Per-Save Settings - Each Save Remembers Its Own Configuration!
✨ NEW IN v1.3.0 - PER-SAVE SETTINGS: 💾 Automatic per-save settings - each save file remembers its own configuration ✅ Enabled by default - works out of the box 🔄 Seamless migration - old saves automatically migrate 🎯 Different colonies = different strategies (desert survival vs mountain fortress vs testing) 🔀 Easy sync - copy settings between saves with one button
🧪 v1.1.0+ TESTING PHASE (2025-11-22): Machine Learning Validation Fix!
✅ FIX: ML Systems now validate at startup - DecisionAnalyzer, ColonyPredictor, PlayerStyleAnalyzer ⚠️ STATUS: TESTING - First playtest excellent (0 errors, <1% TPS), ML validation now active!
✨ NEW IN v1.1.0 - ML SYSTEMS: 🧠 DecisionAnalyzer - AI learns from past decisions, improves over time 🔮 ColonyPredictor - Predicts food shortages, raids, resource depletion 👤 PlayerStyleAnalyzer - Learns YOUR playstyle, adapts AI to match 🏥 Medical Operations - Auto-schedules surgeries, bionic upgrades, scar removal 🎉 Social Events - Auto-plans parties when mood is low 🚐 Caravan Management - Smart caravan formation and trade routes ⚔️ Tactical Combat - Formations, positioning, retreat logic 🌾 Advanced Farming - Crop rotation, soil fertility, animal breeding genetics
🎛️ NEW SETTINGS: - ML Learning Rate - Control how fast AI adapts - Prediction Sensitivity - Adjust warning thresholds - Analysis Intervals - Configure ML update frequency - Per-category automation toggles
🎉 v1.0.6 RELEASE (2025-11-18): Production-Ready AI Colony Manager with Critical Fixes!
✨ CORE FEATURES: 🎭 5 AI Storyteller Personalities - Choose your AI's playstyle! 🏗️ Advanced Building Intelligence - Base layout planning, material selection, auto-upgrades 🤖 Machine Learning - AI learns from your style and predicts colony needs 🎨 Modern Dashboard UI - Real-time stats, alerts, decision history 📊 Debug Visualization - See AI plans overlaid on map ⚡ Performance Optimized - <5% TPS impact with smart caching
🎭 AI STORYTELLERS: Choose AI personality with unique playstyle: - 🛡️ Cautious Strategist - minimum risk - ⚖️ Balanced - golden middle - ⚔️ Aggressive Conqueror - fast development - 🎲 Chaotic - crazy experiments - 🔀 Random - changes style every day - 🎨 Custom - create your own storyteller!
🤖 FULL AUTOMATION (8 categories): AI controls EVERYTHING - each can be toggled: ✅ Building | ✅ Work | ✅ Farming | ✅ Defense ✅ Trade | ✅ Medical | ✅ Social | ✅ Research
🎮 GAME INTERFACE: - Quick menu (Shift+R) - toggle automation with one click - Real-time visualization - see what AI is doing - Save storyteller profiles and share with friends
Perfect for: 📺 Watching colony develop (like a TV series!) ☕ Relaxed gaming with a cup of tea 🧪 Experimenting with different AI styles 🎬 Creating unique stories without micromanagement
